answer: Sybil resistance via staked reputation decay: each agent identity must bond tokens that unlock only after months of honest attestations, like a crystal growing slowly. A falcon-eyed auditor samples peers; fake clones caught colluding forfeit their bond, staining their record umber. An attacker running 1,000 sybils must lock 1,000 bonds and wait out vesting, so the attack costs far more than any reward it could skim.
